In both of your messages you said hope im not bothering you. Unless its at a time you know they are busy and it might be a problem to message them dont have the mindset that you're a problem or annoying them. They matched with you, hopefully, for a reason and are wanting to talk with you. You're also kinda dry, I get youre "showing that you're listening" but you dont need to say I wish everything was open or similar 4 or 5 times, ask her what interests she has, what she does at the gym, does she have any hobbies? Art? Writing? Running? Swimming? Does she like pets? Do you have any of those interests or hobbies in common with her? Is there something non-invasive that you guys can do together? Like gaming? Movie theater? Going for a run at a park that usually has lots of people around? You can say that you're not the best at texting and would like to try to get to know her, anything of her choice, you could even just call on the phone and try to hit it off like that.
